{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the shape
print(f"Data shape: {df.shape}")

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1].count()
print(f"Number of patients with multiple rows: {duplicates}")

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}")

# Check the unique values of assay_batch
print(f"Unique assay_batch values: {df['assay_batch'].unique()}")

# Check the unique values of sample_seq
print(f"Unique sample_seq values: {df['sample_seq'].unique()}")

# Check distribution of sample_seq per patient
df_sample_seq_max = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f"Max sample_seq per patient: {df_sample_seq_max.describe()}")"}
